text: Traffic of trailer and semi-trailer vehicles is prohibited on the Nakerala Pass and on the Sachkhere (Sareki)-Uzunta-Shkmeri-Zudali road.

Due to snowfall, the movement of trailer and semi-trailer vehicles is temporarily prohibited on the section of the domestic road of state importance Kutaisi (Motsameta)-Tkibuli-Ambrolauri highway km39-km60 (Nakerala Pass) and on the Sachkhere (Sareki)-Uzunta-Shkmeri-Zudali road.
The information is disseminated by the Roads Department of the Ministry of Infrastructure of Georgia. According to them, the movement of other types of motor vehicles is free.
